sepal_length_cm: How long the green leaf-like part under the petals is, measured in centimetres. Bigger irises usually have longer sepals.
sepal_width_cm: How wide that same green leaf-like part is, measured in centimetres.
petal_length_cm: How long the colourful petal of the flower is, measured in centimetres. Setosa petals are very short, versicolor petals are medium, and virginica petals are the longest.
petal_width_cm: How wide the colourful petal is, measured in centimetres. Setosa petals are very narrow, versicolor petals are medium, and virginica petals are the widest.
species: Which kind of iris flower this is — one of 'setosa', 'versicolor', or 'virginica'. This is the column we want to predict for new flowers.
